From: security@acme.com

Cc: audits@verifier.io
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Enclave airlock narrative & SIG evidence request

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. Acme's security team is preparing a SIG + CAIQ review for our legal and cloud-security committee next month. To close a few open items we need: 1) a concise security architecture narrative that explains the 'airlock' / enclave demarcation between your Hosted/Dedicated and Private offerings, 2) the latest network diagram that highlights ingress/egress controls for Private (VPC) and dedicated GPU pools, and 3) a mapping of SIG control IDs to where evidence lives.

Specific asks: 
- A 1-2 page narrative suitable for SOC2/SIG reviewers describing how requests are routed, where customer data is processed in Private deployments, and blast-radius controls.
- A network diagram (PNG or PDF) that annotates control-plane vs data-plane, airlock boundaries, and any gateway/proxy layers.
- A matrix (xlsx or CSV) listing SIG/CIS/SOC2 control IDs and the document/evidence filename.

Can you confirm ETA for these artifacts? Ideally by EOD Friday (2027-03-05). If you need a narrower scope, tell us what you can provide by Friday and what will follow.

Regards,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Security, Acme Corp
security@acme.com
From: michael_grant@redwood.example.com
To: security@acme.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, mina_haddad@redwood.example.com, audits@verifier.io
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Enclave airlock narrative & SIG evidence request

Lena — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a curated evidence package and a short narrative by Friday. High-level plan below, attaching a draft narrative and the current diagram for internal review.

What we'll provide by 2027-03-05 (finalized):
- Enclave Airlock Narrative (1.5 pages) that covers: request routing, isolation boundaries (Private vs Dedicated), customer data residency guarantees, KMS/HSM borders, and fallback/failover behavior.
- Annotated Network Diagram (PNG) showing control-plane / data-plane split, private VPC ingress patterns, egress filtering, and dedicated GPU pool demarcation.
- Segmentation Control Matrix (XLSX) mapping SIG questions to evidence (logs, policy docs, runbooks, screenshots).
- SIG answer pack (PDF) with references to doc IDs and drive links.

Internal notes / asks: Kim, Mina — I'm attaching the draft narrative (enclave-airlock-narrative-v1.docx) and a working diagram (enclave-diagram-v3.png). Please: 1) review the narrative for any gaps in the KMS/tenant-fencing section, 2) update the diagram to show the latest NAT/egress gateway placement for Private, and 3) populate the segmentation-control-matrix.xlsx with links to the evidence artifacts you own.

If we can't complete everything by Friday, we'll deliver the narrative + diagram and a partial matrix, then follow with the full matrix early next week.

Thanks — Michael
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

On Tue, Mar 2, 2027 at 11:03 AM Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.example.com> wrote:
> Lena — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a curated evidence package and a short narrative by Friday. High-level plan below, attaching a draft narrative and the current diagram for internal review.

Michael / team — rapid review below. I updated the diagram (minor layout + edge labels) and started a segregation matrix. Key clarifications to include in the narrative:
- The Private offering places customer model inference in customer-controlled VPCs; the control-plane is a customer-managed connector and a minimal agent that only performs orchestration and never persists customer prompts to our hosted control-plane.
- For Dedicated pools, we run within Redwood-managed subnets with strict tenant isolation (vlan/GPU-enclave level) and per-tenant KMS key wrapping. Document the fallback path: when Dedicated capacity is exhausted we offer routing to a pinned model variant (customer-configurable) rather than falling back to a general hosted model.
- Egress: show egress-only NAT gateway in Private with policy-based filtering (deny by default), audited by flow logs retained per contract.

I've attached a new version of enclave-diagram-v3.png (annotated) and a starter segmentation-control-matrix.xlsx with rows for SIG items we own. Mina — can you add the runbook/ops play for tenant-eviction and the KMS attest screenshot to the evidence column?

Kimberly Park
Director, Security Architecture — Redwood Inference
